BiblicalUsage: Kelubai, Chelubai, is a son of Hezron, named in the genealogy of Judah. 1 Chronicles 2:9 says the sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him, Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Chelubai's one verse is enough: he is counted among the sons of Judah, in the line that leads to David and to Christ.
